description: End-to-end MELT view of Cisco Virtual Kubelet's MDT-over-gNMI to OpenTelemetry pipeline. Shows device-side gNMI counters, the CVK self-observability metrics that describe the pipeline's own health, log records flowing through the mapper, and Phase 4 transition spans. Designed for the IOSXETelemetry CRD + the otelproviders / mapper / classifier / emit packages introduced in PR #115.

panels.description: One row per app on the device. Columns are pinned-resource-attribute values from the IOS-XE app-hosting-oper YANG tree (state, image type, version, package, network endpoint).

targets.expr: group by (name, cisco_app_hosting_state, cisco_app_hosting_image_type, cisco_app_hosting_version, cisco_app_hosting_package_name, cisco_app_hosting_owner, cisco_app_hosting_profile, cisco_app_hosting_ipv4_address, cisco_app_hosting_mac_address, cisco_app_hosting_network_name, cisco_app_hosting_attached_interface) ({__name__=~"cvk_app_hosting_app_name_.*_details_health_status"})
